name: Barber Packaging Company
old_description: Family-owned and operated since 1989, we believe in building true partnerships.
about:
Barber Packaging Company was established in 1989 in Bangor, Michigan, as a family-owned and operated business. The company has remained under family ownership for more than 35 years, building its reputation on long-term customer partnerships.

The company provides engineered packaging solutions across five categories: returnable packaging made from steel, wood, plastics, textiles, and foam; expendable one-way packaging for export, service, backup, and retail; work-in-progress (WIP) intra-plant material handling systems; service and backup packaging to OEM specifications; and export packaging designed for sea containers and intermodal transport. Barber’s in-house design team uses CAD to create 3D models from customer data, and its rapid prototyping service delivers form-fit-test-review cycles. A manufacturing floor described as one of the industry’s most capable produces custom protective packaging, while validation and testing—including shake and drop tests performed with accredited labs—ensure compliance. Program management covers design concept through system fills.

Barber serves a range of industries that require protective packaging, with specific references to assembly plants and OEM supply chains. Its returnable and expendable products are used in automotive and industrial settings, though the company does not publicly list individual industry verticals.

The company differentiates itself through what it calls “The Barber Way”—a relationship-based approach that emphasizes consistency, collaboration, and single-source coordination. Customers cite faster turnaround times, cost savings, and simplified project management as key reasons for partnering with Barber.
